caption: A clear cylindrical glass rests on a pale surface against a teal wall. Inside it sit two unmixed liquid layers: a golden-yellow band floating above a transparent lower layer, with a soft white sediment settled at the bottom. A yellow drinking straw is inserted through the liquids, its upper end protruding above the rim. Tiny bubbles and droplets cling to the straw within the yellow band. Across the excerpt the straw's apparent orientation changes: it shifts from a nearly vertical stance to a more pronounced slant, its top end moving toward the right side of the rim while its lower end drifts leftward within the glass. Meanwhile the whole glass and its contents drift progressively leftward in frame, the soft shadow at the left background edge shifting with them. Throughout, the golden-yellow band and the clear layer hold a constant vertical position and thickness. The white sediment at the bottom stays undisturbed as the angled straw continues to shift.
relations: As the yellow straw tilts from vertical toward a slant, its top end moves right past the rim while its lower end drifts left within the clear layer.
When the glass drifts leftward in frame, its contents and the left-edge shadow shift together while the liquid layers hold constant height and thickness.
While the angled straw continues to shift, the golden-yellow band and transparent layer remain vertically stable and unmixed.
As the straw reorients, the white sediment at the bottom stays undisturbed beneath the clear layer.
